name: Phys3DGS
aliases: Physically-based 3D Gaussian Splatting for Inverse Rendering
definition: A physically-based inverse rendering method that uses deferred rendering and a mesh-3DGS hybrid representation to solve the 'hidden Gaussian' problem where Gaussians beneath the surface adversely affect pixel color in volume rendering.
summary: Phys3DGS is a physically-based inverse rendering method that resolves the hidden Gaussian problem by decoupling geometry and material learning through a mesh-3DGS hybrid representation and deferred rendering.
